        ELSE 'PENDING'
    END                                             AS LOAN_STATUS,
    CASE
        WHEN pa.LAST_PAYMENT_DATE IS NOT NULL
             AND DATEDIFF(DAY, pa.LAST_PAYMENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30
        THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES'
    END                                             AS DELINQUENCY_FLAG
